notablePrerequisites:
Xerex Strobe-Knight does not have summoning sickness.
You have a storm count of at least two.
description:
Activate Xerex Strobe-Knight by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Knight creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Knight.
When the Knight dies, Xerex Strobe-Knight triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Knight's power.
Repeat.
